## Clean-room declaration (required)

Before submitting, confirm the following. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full policy.

> **I declare that I have never read, studied, decompiled, or otherwise accessed the source code, assets, or any other implementation material of [Apostrophe](https://gitlab.gnome.org/World/apostrophe), and that my contribution contains nothing derived from them.**

If you *have* read Apostrophe's implementation in the past, do **not** check the box — instead describe below what you read and how thoroughly, so the maintainers can decide whether the contribution is still acceptable.

- [ ] I make the clean-room declaration above.
